candidate_unit: one externally supported biological relation plus prospectively identifiable independent event-answer and function-answer channels on a common frozen event key
motivation_from_v2: v2 showed that function-level biological relation closure can pass while evidence independence remains the binding bottleneck; v3 therefore moves source separation into candidate identity rather than weakening G5 after discovery

three_channel_architecture.R_relation_channel: primary external evidence establishing only the directional biological implication E(k)->F(k)
three_channel_architecture.X_event_answer_channel: independent source capable in principle of estimating the event-side answer E at the frozen key
three_channel_architecture.Y_function_answer_channel: independent source capable in principle of estimating the required biological function F at the same frozen key

candidate_discovery_queries_frozen_in_or: obligate pollination reproductive dependence independent monitoring dataset exact site phenology
pollinator exclusion reproductive success independent visitation monitoring same locality season
host dependent development independent host monitoring dataset exact site phenology
obligate symbiosis stage transition independent partner monitoring exact site time window

prevalue_architecture_gates.A1_hard_relation_source: primary external source supports the exact directional event-to-function implication
prevalue_architecture_gates.A2_event_answer_source_identity: an independent event-answer source or prospectively fixed sampling stream is identifiable from metadata without opening focal values
prevalue_architecture_gates.A3_function_answer_source_identity: an independent function-answer source or prospectively fixed sampling stream is identifiable from metadata without opening focal values
prevalue_architecture_gates.A4_three_way_independence: R, X, and Y satisfy the frozen source-identity rule
prevalue_architecture_gates.A5_common_operational_space: metadata support a common exact or unambiguous relation-space key
prevalue_architecture_gates.A6_common_operational_time: metadata support a common event-specific temporal key or window
prevalue_architecture_gates.A7_estimand_alignment: X measures E and Y measures F; occurrence or suitability cannot be silently substituted
prevalue_architecture_gates.A8_management_scope: the focal relation-space pattern is not created by release, cultivation, placement, or comparable intervention unless the declared target is explicitly experimental
prevalue_architecture_gates.A9_fresh_endpoint_identity: the system was not consumed or screened in Level-C v1 or v2 and is not a relabelled prior endpoint

candidate_registry_rule.hard_stop_rule: stop when 3 candidates pass A1-A9 or 12 candidates have been screened, whichever happens first
